g.text: User
User
Backend
Backend
Frontend
Frontend
Backend is in operation, or it gives an error response.
User has a web browser and the address of the page.
User opens the page of the application in the browser.
Frontend shows User the waiting message for the information of the service.
Frontend sends the request GET /info to Backend.
Backend sends the response with the version, the commit, the copyright holder, the address of the repository and the license to Frontend.
alt
[Backend sends an error response]
Backend sends the error response with the error code and the trace identifier to Frontend.
Frontend shows User the heading that the information is not available, the text for the error code, and the trace identifier.
The text is in the language of the page. Frontend does not show the members title and detail of the error response.
alt
[Backend gives no response]
Frontend shows User the heading that the information is not available and the text that the service gives no response.
There is no trace identifier in this case.
alt
[Backend sends a response that Frontend cannot read]
Frontend shows User the heading that the information is not available and the text that the response of the service is not valid.
There is no trace identifier in this case.
Frontend shows User the notice of the license at the bottom of the page, in the language of the page.
Step 4: Frontend shows the notice as
English: Copyright 2026 Ronald Rink, https://github.com/dfch/biz.dfch.SpecMgrDemo. Licensed under AGPL-3.0-only.
German: Copyright 2026 Ronald Rink, https://github.com/dfch/biz.dfch.SpecMgrDemo. Lizenziert unter AGPL-3.0-only.
Frontend shows User the version and the commit of the build, in the language of the page.
Step 5: Frontend shows the version as
English: Version {version}, commit {commit}
German: Version {version}, Commit {commit}
User reads the notice of the license, the version and the commit.
The page shows the notice of the license (the copyright holder, the address of the repository and the license).
The page shows the version and the commit of the build.
The page shows the heading that the information is not available, and the text for the cause.
The page shows no notice, no version and no commit.
